answers.rationale: This requirement pertains to shipping and handling, which is not a product-specific requirement. The bid manager should address this.

The requirement specifies 15 kV metal-clad switchgear with specific electrical characteristics. The CROWN-ARMV product is the appropriate choice as it is designed for metal-clad MV switchgear with vacuum breakers and meets IEEE C37.20.2 standards.
The requirement specifies rigid bus bars and shipping braces for utility CT connections, which are features of the CROWN-ARMV product, as it is designed for robust and reliable metal-clad switchgear.

The requirement specifies features of the circuit breaker compartment and breakers, which align with the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product, designed for 15 kV metal-clad switchgear with vacuum breakers.
The requirement specifies operation on a solidly grounded 13.2 kV system, which is within the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product.
The requirement specifies a gang-operated isolation switch for incoming feeders. This is a standard accessory for MV switchgear, which aligns with the CROWN-ACC product.
The requirement specifies metering CTs and VTs with specific configurations, which are accessories for MV switchgear. The CROWN-ACC product includes such accessories.
